title: Bound quest item definitions
description: Capacity-independent, source-bound quest items and their authored Read effects.

items.description: Unique item and source quest pairs; cross-references are checked by the loader.

id.description: Quest item definition identity; this does not identify equippable gear.

sourceQuestId.description: The sole quest whose questItem reward may issue this entitlement.

effect.description: Read effect, applied once when the entitlement is consumed.

skillPoints.description: Authored positive safe-integer unspent skill points granted by Read.
